name: AI Images generator
description:
Updated the `AIModelType` enumeration to include a new `image` category for multi-modal support.
Enhanced the Python `AI` class to manage provider-specific image generation logic via a factory method.
Defined a Strategy Pattern architecture in TypeScript to handle provider switching between OpenAI and Gemini.
Implemented dedicated service handlers for OpenAI (DALL-E) and Gemini (Imagen) to standardize outputs.
Configured project and model settings to ensure a consistent and extensible image generation interface.

[OpenAI DALL·E 3 API Documentation](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/images)
[Google Gemini Imagen 3 Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/image/generate-images)

messages.content:
We need a new functionality for AI images generation. We'll have a class to define the images generation that will receive:
* Project settings
* AIModelSettings
And will expose the image generation method.


Will have classes for each AI image generation provider: Gemini Nano bananas, OpenAI GPT... and it will be selected based on the AISettings provider information.

* Add new model type: Image
* Extend AI class to have image generation
* Create a new provider for Gemini
